The '''Corulag security force''' was a local military unit on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. [[Vildar Blin]] served with the organization before joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
